generationWindow: After successful saved ten-minute check, before jump

deliveryStyle.greeting: Always begin with a classic NZ greeting: Kia ora, team; Gidday, team; or Kia ora, good sorts.
deliveryStyle.voice: Natural New Zealand conversational delivery using the selected Geoff voice.
deliveryStyle.frequency: One or two light expressions through the tips, not every sentence.
deliveryStyle.facts: Keep horse names, tipster attributions, source facts, assumptions and confidence caveats exact. Never add certainty or call a horse a sure thing.

editorialStyle: Evidence first: verified tip count and coverage, top of the original ladder, material late changes and fresh attributed social tips. Confidence ratings stay unchanged; avoid repeating low-confidence caveats.
